Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited, has filed the present petitions for adjudication of claims arising from change in law and consequential reliefs as per the provisions of the PPAs dated 18.1.2014 and 20.1.2014 entered with the distribution companies of Uttar Pradesh. The Commission vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 5.5.2016 had issued notice on admissibility of the petition, particularly on the issue of composite scheme of the generating station of the petitioner. 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner vide its letter dated 9.9.2016 has sought permission to withdraw both petitions with liberty to institute fresh petition detailing all claims at a later stage. 3. Noting the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, we dispose of the Petition Nos. 47/MP/2016 and 58/MP/2016 as withdrawn. The petitioner is at liberty to file the fresh petition, if any in accordance with law. Sd/sd/sd/sd/- **(Dr. M.K.Iyer) (A.S. Bakshi) (A. K. Singhal) (Gireesh B.
